interactions.mechanism: Pharmacodynamic synergism: Concurrent administration of multiple NSAIDs significantly elevates gastrointestinal bleeding risk and blunts irreversible COX-1 platelet inhibition by low-dose aspirin.
interactions.management: Avoid concurrent use. If antiplatelet cardioprotection is indicated, administer immediate-release aspirin at least 30 minutes before or 8 hours after ibuprofen.
interactions.recommendation: KHÔNG dùng đồng thời. Tham vấn bác sĩ để lựa chọn phác đồ giảm đau an toàn.

interactions.mechanism: Pharmacodynamic synergism: Combined COX inhibition severely increases upper GI ulceration and bleeding risk.
interactions.management: Avoid concurrent use. Use alternative non-ulcerogenic analgesics under medical supervision.
interactions.recommendation: KHÔNG dùng đồng thời. Nguy cơ xuất huyết tiêu hóa cao.

interactions.mechanism: Combined antiplatelet and anticoagulant effect produces extreme risk of major or life-threatening hemorrhage.
interactions.management: Co-administration requires strict cardiologic indication and intensive INR monitoring.
interactions.recommendation: Nguy hiểm: Tránh phối hợp trừ khi có chỉ định chuyên khoa tim mạch. Theo dõi INR.

interactions.mechanism: NSAIDs cause gastric mucosal injury and platelet inhibition while warfarin impairs coagulation, resulting in severe bleeding.
interactions.management: Avoid NSAID co-therapy. Use acetaminophen/paracetamol at low doses for analgesia.
interactions.recommendation: Tránh phối hợp. Ưu tiên Paracetamol liều thấp nếu cần giảm đau.

interactions.mechanism: High sustained acetaminophen doses (>2000mg/day) inhibit vitamin K-dependent clotting factor synthesis, augmenting INR.
interactions.management: Limit acetaminophen to under 2000mg/day and monitor INR if taken for >3 consecutive days.
interactions.recommendation: Thận trọng: Không dùng quá 2g Paracetamol/ngày khi đang dùng Warfarin.

interactions.mechanism: Chelation binding between multivalent calcium cations and fluoroquinolones reduces fluoroquinolone bioavailability by 50-80%.
interactions.management: Administer ciprofloxacin at least 2 hours before or 6 hours after calcium-containing foods or supplements.
interactions.recommendation: Uống Ciprofloxacin cách các sản phẩm chứa Canxi ít nhất 2 giờ.

interactions.mechanism: Ferrous iron forms insoluble chelates with ciprofloxacin in the digestive tract, severely diminishing systemic absorption.
interactions.management: Space administration by at least 2 hours before or 4 hours after oral iron.
interactions.recommendation: Uống Ciprofloxacin cách viên uống bổ sung Sắt ít nhất 2-4 giờ.

interactions.mechanism: Penicillins compete for renal tubular secretion via OAT1/OAT3 transporters, decreasing methotrexate renal clearance and causing toxic myelosuppression.
interactions.management: Monitor methotrexate plasma levels and complete blood count closely; consider dose adjustment.
interactions.recommendation: Nguy hiểm: Tăng độc tính tủy xương và thận của Methotrexate. Thông báo bác sĩ.

interactions.mechanism: Amiodarone inhibits CYP3A4-mediated simvastatin metabolism, markedly raising simvastatin plasma concentrations and rhabdomyolysis risk.
interactions.management: Do not exceed simvastatin 20mg daily when co-administered with amiodarone.
interactions.recommendation: Nguy hiểm: Tăng nguy cơ tiêu cơ vân. Giới hạn Simvastatin tối đa 20mg/ngày.

interactions.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inhibition by clarithromycin increases simvastatin AUC up to 10-fold, triggering acute kidney injury and rhabdomyolysis.
interactions.management: Contraindicated. Temporarily suspend simvastatin therapy during clarithromycin antibiotic course.
interactions.recommendation: Chống chỉ định: TẠM NGƯNG Simvastatin trong toàn bộ thời gian uống Clarithromycin.

interactions.mechanism: Omeprazole competitively inhibits CYP2C19, impairing metabolic bioactivation of clopidogrel and reducing antiplatelet efficacy.
interactions.management: Consider switching to pantoprazole or famotidine which exhibit minimal CYP2C19 inhibition.
interactions.recommendation: Cân nhắc thay Omeprazole bằng Pantoprazole để bảo toàn tác dụng của Clopidogrel.

interactions.mechanism: Alcohol potentiates metformin-induced lactic acidosis by inhibiting hepatic lactate gluconeogenesis, particularly in fasting states.
interactions.management: Avoid excessive acute or chronic alcohol intake during metformin treatment.
interactions.recommendation: Tránh uống rượu bia khi đang điều trị đái tháo đường bằng Metformin.

interactions.mechanism: Amiodarone inhibits P-glycoprotein efflux transporter and renal clearance, increasing digoxin serum levels by 70-100% and causing cardiac arrhythmias.
interactions.management: Reduce digoxin dosage by 50% upon starting amiodarone and monitor serum digoxin levels.
interactions.recommendation: Nguy hiểm: Tăng nồng độ Digoxin gây ngộ độc tim. Giảm 50% liều Digoxin và theo dõi nồng độ.

interactions.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inhibition by clarithromycin significantly increases atorvastatin exposure, heightening myopathy and hepatotoxicity risk.
interactions.management: Limit atorvastatin to lowest effective dose or temporarily pause during short-term clarithromycin therapy.
interactions.recommendation: Thận trọng cao: Giảm liều Atorvastatin hoặc tạm ngưng khi dùng kháng sinh Clarithromycin.

interactions.mechanism: Calcium carbonate binds levothyroxine in acidic gastric environment, reducing thyroid hormone absorption and causing hypothyroidism.
interactions.management: Separate administration times by at least 4 hours.
interactions.recommendation: Uống Levothyroxine cách viên Canxi ít nhất 4 giờ để tránh giảm hấp thu hormone tuyến giáp.

interactions.mechanism: Oral iron supplements form an unabsorbable complex with levothyroxine in the GI tract.
interactions.management: Administer levothyroxine at least 4 hours before or after oral iron products.
interactions.recommendation: Uống Levothyroxine cách viên Sắt ít nhất 4 giờ.

interactions.mechanism: Angiotensin II receptor blockade decreases aldosterone secretion, promoting potassium retention and hyperkalemia risk when combined with potassium supplements.
interactions.management: Monitor serum potassium levels routinely. Avoid potassium supplements unless clinically indicated.
interactions.recommendation: Thận trọng: Tăng nguy cơ tăng Kali máu nguy hiểm. Kiểm tra Kali huyết định kỳ.

interactions.mechanism: Concurrent ACE inhibition and aldosterone antagonism synergistic retention of potassium, elevating life-threatening hyperkalemia risk.
interactions.management: Strictly monitor serum potassium and renal function within 1-2 weeks of initiation and regularly thereafter.
interactions.recommendation: Nguy hiểm: Nguy cơ tăng Kali máu nặng. Bắt buộc theo dõi chức năng thận và điện giải đồ.

interactions.mechanism: Combined serotonergic actions plus CYP2D6 inhibition by fluoxetine increase free tramadol and serotonin levels, triggering Serotonin Syndrome and seizures.
interactions.management: Avoid combination. Monitor for mental status changes, tremor, hyperreflexia, and diaphoresis.
interactions.recommendation: Chống chỉ định: Nguy cơ Hội chứng Serotonin và co giật đe dọa tính mạng. Tránh phối hợp.

interactions.mechanism: PDE5 inhibitors and nitrates both amplify cGMP signaling, inducing profound and potentially fatal systemic hypotension.
interactions.management: Absolute contraindication. Nitrates should not be administered within 24 hours of sildenafil.
interactions.recommendation: Chống chỉ định tuyệt đối: Tụt huyết áp nghiêm trọng đe dọa tính mạng. KHÔNG dùng đồng thời.
